user.title: Connect to your FlexiObox
user.description: Enter the hostname or IP address of your FlexiObox. It must be on the same network as Home Assistant.

data_description.host: Usually {default_host}. Use the IP address instead if that name does not resolve.

reconfigure.title: Update your FlexiObox connection
reconfigure.description: Enter the new hostname or IP address of your FlexiObox.

data_description.host: Usually {default_host}. Use the IP address instead if that name does not resolve.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check that the FlexiObox is powered on and reachable from Home Assistant.
error.invalid_response: That host responded, but it does not look like a FlexiObox.

init.title: Polling
init.description: How often to read the FlexiObox. It answers in milliseconds and is on your own network, so a few seconds is fine. Faster polling means more states recorded in your database.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between readings. Default 10, minimum 2. The FlexiO app itself refreshes every few seconds.

invalid_response.message: The FlexiObox returned an unexpected response

invalid_price.message: The FlexiObox rejected {price} as a maximum price. Prices must not be negative.

write_failed.message: Failed to write the new maximum price to the FlexiObox at {host}
